hooks.name: engine-tests-on-save
hooks.description: Run the engine test suite (examples + property-based tests) whenever an engine file is saved.

hooks.name: self-audit-on-style-change
hooks.description: Ghostlight must pass its own audit: when styles.css changes, ask the agent to re-check the UI palette.

action.prompt: styles.css changed. Use src/engine/color.js to check every --text-on-surface pair defined in :root still meets 4.5:1 and list any ghosts with exorcised replacements.
